Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study performs both global proteomics and N-glycoproteomics. The glycoproteomics workflow uses TMT labeling and MAX enrichment for intact glycopeptides, analyzed via DDA-HCD. The 'strucgp' software is used for de novo structural sequencing of N-glycans.

scope: Liver tissues (~ 50 mg tissue per sample) were cut into pieces and washed twice with precooled PBS to remove serum. Then, tissues were suspended with 8 m urea/1 m NH4HCO3 buffer, homogenized using an automatic rapid tissue homogenizer (60 Hz, Shanghai Jing Xin, China) and sonicated by ultrasonic cell distribution system until the upper solution was clear.

The proteins were then reduced by 5 mm dithiothreitol (DTT) at 37 °C for 1 h and alkylated by 15 mm iodoacetamide in the dark for 30 min at room temperature (RT), followed by addition of another 2.5 mm DTT for 10 min at RT. Protein pellet solutions were digested overnight by sequencing grade trypsin

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The experiment involved both global proteomics and glycoproteomics. While glycopeptides were enriched using mixed anion-exchange columns (MAX) prior to LC-MS/MS, the starting material for both the global proteome and the glycoproteome was the total protein extract (homogenized tissue lysate) from liver tumors and paracancer tissues.
